SELECT f.FACILITY_ID AS facilityId, f.NAME AS name, f.ADDRESS AS address, f.DOMAIN AS domain, f.ZONE AS zone, f.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, f.STATUS AS status, ip.INSPECTOR_ID AS inspectorId, ip.NAME AS inspectorName, ip.PHONE AS inspectorPhone
FROM FACILITIES f LEFT JOIN INSPECTOR_PROFILE ip ON ip.INSPECTOR_ID = f.INSPECTOR_ID WHERE f.FACILITY_ID = #{facilityId}
